items.title: Nessel Appeals Fast-Track DTE Deals for 1.4-Gigawatt Washtenaw Data Center
items.dek: The attorney general wants the contracts with Green Chile Ventures sent back for a full hearing, citing hidden costs and the risk of higher electric bills for Michigan customers.
items.judge_note: Major new development: AG Nessel escalates her PSC challenge with a formal appeal targeting specific 1.4-GW contracts, moving beyond her earlier demand for answ

items.title: Bitcoin Sales Fund Hyperscale Michigan AI Campus With 20 MW Capacity
items.dek: Hyperscale sold roughly 100 Bitcoin and added a credit facility to build the Michigan campus, expected to deliver more than $1.2 billion in revenue over the initial 10-year term.
items.judge_note: Real project announcement with financing details and Michigan location, but thin on local impact, permitting status, or community response that would elevate it

items.title: Michigan Bills Would Require Data Centers to Pay Their Own Power and Community Costs
items.dek: Democrats' package mandates 15- to 20-year contracts, 90% clean energy, and binding local agreements so residents do not cover water, electricity, or decommissioning expenses.
items.judge_note: Concrete legislative package with specific mandates (15-20 year contracts, 90% clean energy, cost-shifting provisions) — a real filing/proposal, not just talk.
